title: patch workflow (.github/workflows/patch.js): read PR author, body, labels and number from context.payload.pull_request instead of re-fetching them via the API
answers: Why does the patch-release labeling workflow make extra GitHub API calls for pull request details and labels?
How does the patch workflow decide to skip bot-authored PRs and PRs already carrying a version label?
Where is the code that adds a vX.Y.Z patch label to a PR handled?
How do I add another PR field, such as title or base branch, to the patch labeling logic?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/patch.js:module.exports handles the github-script step that runs on pull request events to decide whether a PR gets a patch-release version label. It reads base, body, labels, number and user from the event payload, skips branch-X.Y targets and bot-authored PRs (except Copilot), finds an existing vX.Y.Z label, lists releases, and writes the label with github.rest.issues.addLabels.
Rule: Use the event snapshot in context.payload.pull_request for PR fields the workflow needs (body, user, labels, number, base). Do not call pulls.get or issues.listLabelsOnIssue to re-read them; only call the API for data the payload does not carry (such as releases) or for writes (addLabels). Version-label detection runs as labels.find(...) over the payload labels.
Constraints: Payload values reflect the PR state when the triggering event fired, so a label or body edited mid-run will not be seen. Applies to this workflow's pull_request event path; does not change the release-listing or label-writing calls.
applies: Applies to the patch-release labeling github-script in .github/workflows/patch.js; not to other workflows that legitimately need fresh API state.
says: Patch release labeling is making redundant GitHub requests for pull request metadata.
Automated version tagger should inspect pull request authors without calling the remote service.
Prevent automated patch version labels from being added to bot pull requests.
Pull requests targeting maintenance branches should not receive patch version labels.
Check existing version labels directly from the event data instead of querying labels again.

Remote API calls are restricted to listing releases and writing labels via github.rest.issues.addLabels, with version-label detection using labels.find over payload labels while skipping bot authors except Copilot and branch-X.Y targets. This rule applies only to .github/workflows/patch.js on pull_request events, with the constraint that payload data reflects the event snapshot and will not reflect mid-run edits.
